fact: INEGE presented the ninth edition of the national Statistical Yearbook, Anuario Estadistico de Guinea Ecuatorial 2026, on 2026-09-25, covering official demographic, social, economic, financial, environmental and administrative data for the last five years.
INEGE presented the eighth edition of the national statistical yearbook on 2025-10-31, with data to December 2024, compiled from data supplied by ministries and official bodies.
INEGE published Hechos Vitales Guinea Ecuatorial 2023, edition no. 1, in October 2024, covering births, deaths, marriages and divorces in 2023.
INEGE published edition no. 1 of Hechos Vitales Guinea Ecuatorial 2023 in October 2024, with chapters on births and deaths for 2023.

INEGE presented the ninth national Statistical Yearbook on 2026-09-25, with data to December 2025 compiled from ministerial departments' returns, reporting 20,152 civil servants and 2,731 hires in 2025.
